journeys.context: A diagram is configured and ready for generation or later reproduction.
journeys.goal: Generate a Result and reproduce it from the same canonical state after a Session round trip.
steps: Configure the diagram inputs and layout
Save and reload the Session when needed
Generate again from the restored canonical state

effects.statement: At Generate submission, the render request reflects the current canonical UI and Session model.
Reloaded and freshly generated output use the same request semantics.

options.summary: Fresh generation and replay converge on one typed canonical render-request boundary.

contracts.ref: tests/web/architecture-contracts.test.mjs::production rendering crosses the canonical request and Worker boundary
contracts.residualRisk: This contract fixes the Generate-to-request and Worker wiring but does not compare every projected UI field or a Session round trip.

contracts.ref: tests/web/contracts/session-regenerate-intent.playwright.spec.js::no-draft session preserves preview, active config, canonical request, and catalog
contracts.residualRisk: The browser contract exercises one representative current no-draft Session during dev staging; alternate modes, migrations, and every request field are not exhaustively covered here.

contracts.ref: tests/web/session-request.test.mjs::canonical Session projection rebuilds the same render request
contracts.residualRisk: The DOM-free contract compares one representative current Circular request; browser admission, alternate modes, and Session migrations remain covered separately.

journeys.context: A supported saved Session has a committed preview and may also have a distinct active draft.
journeys.goal: Inspect the saved preview, regenerate safely more than once, and continue editing, exporting, saving, or using History without losing the last successful artifact.
steps: Inspect and interact with the saved preview
Select Generate for the active draft
Wait for the fresh interactive Result
Continue editing, exporting, saving, or using History, including after a failed or canceled attempt

effects.statement: The active draft remains distinct from the committed saved artifact until a successful Generate replaces it.
Generate uses the canonical typed request and executes the renderer for the active draft.
Current Result admission publishes one complete sanitized artifact with its current catalog.
A failed, canceled, superseded, or stale attempt preserves or restores the last successful artifact.
Feature Search, editing, comparison interaction, export, Session save, Undo, and Redo remain available after regeneration.
Generate reports success only after the fresh preview is interactive and ready for the next action.
Processing becomes visible before generation checkpoint work begins.
A second Generate reruns the renderer while reusing the existing Worker and unchanged resources.
The saved preview becomes interactive without constructing the diagram Worker.

options.summary: Saved Session regeneration preserves the committed artifact until one complete current Result becomes interactive, and repeat or failed attempts keep the workflow usable.

contracts.ref: tests/web/architecture-contracts.test.mjs::History intent and SVG admission have one production ownership path
contracts.residualRisk: The structural contract fixes current source ownership and import paths but does not by itself exercise a browser regeneration transaction.

contracts.ref: tests/web/contracts/active-result-edit-transaction.playwright.spec.js::visible tRNA fill scope remains coherent through History, Session, Generate, and SVG export
contracts.residualRisk: The PR-smoke contract covers one representative Feature-fill workflow; other editor domains, comparison modes, and export formats are not exhaustively exercised.

contracts.ref: tests/web/contracts/session-regenerate-intent.playwright.spec.js::no-draft session preserves preview, active config, canonical request, and catalog
contracts.residualRisk: The browser contract covers one representative current no-draft Session; alternate modes, migrations, cancellation, and every continuation remain covered separately.

contracts.ref: tests/web/feature-catalog.test.mjs::one catalog admission produces identities, indexes, scalar footprint, and zero secondary traversal
contracts.residualRisk: The focused catalog contract proves one-pass admission mechanics without mounting a complete saved-Session browser workflow.

contracts.ref: tests/web/hepatoplasmataceae-session-regeneration.performance.playwright.spec.js::exact saved Session regenerates twice with bounded work and fresh readiness
contracts.residualRisk: The exact large saved Session is representative rather than exhaustive across every Session mode, migration, browser, and timing cluster.
The structural matrices validate bounded recovery states and lifecycle evidence but do not synthesize every browser interruption timing.

contracts.ref: tests/web/session-regeneration-contract.test.mjs::accepts saved-preview, first Generate, and second Generate matrices
contracts.residualRisk: The structural matrices require the key lifecycle counts and states but rely on browser contracts to produce representative end-to-end observations.

contracts.ref: tests/web/session-regeneration-contract.test.mjs::rejects second-Generate Worker, renderer, and resource reuse regressions
contracts.residualRisk: The negative structural contract rejects known repeat-generation regressions but does not impose a calibrated elapsed-time threshold.
The lifecycle-order contract protects success and processing visibility boundaries without checking every interactive control.

contracts.ref: tests/web/session-request.test.mjs::canonical Session projection rebuilds the same render request
contracts.residualRisk: The DOM-free request contract compares one representative current Circular projection; alternate modes and browser admission are covered separately.

contracts.ref: tests/web/svg-result-ingestion.test.mjs::current-worker EMPTY admission sanitizes once and performs zero application SVG work
contracts.residualRisk: The focused admission contract verifies current-Worker sanitization and bounded empty mutation work without exercising every editor mutation domain.

scope: Two inventories only. No mapped reference/body, production, checker, policy, authority, timeout, performance budget or Worker-free assertion changed.
